comment: Shared parity fixture for the failure-kind taxonomy. The SAME cases are asserted by pipelines/tests/test_failure_kind.py (classify_failure) and apps/viewer/src/lib/failureKind.test.ts (classifyFailure), so the Python and TypeScript classifiers cannot drift. Each case's fields are the classifier inputs (Python kwargs verbatim; the viewer test maps token_f1->tokenF1, contains_reference->containsReference, n_candidates->nCandidates and sets missing:false); expected_kind is the required return (null = unlabeled) and expected_severity is severity(expected_kind) (minor/major/null) — BOTH classifier and severity are asserted in both suites, since severity() / failureSeverity() is a second dual implementation. No restricted-corpus text appears here — strings are synthetic. Covers every branch of the classifier; add a case (with both expected fields) when a branch is added.

cases.name: refused cell is unlabeled
cases.answer: I'm sorry, I can't help with that.

cases.name: exact correct retrieval is unlabeled
cases.answer: same

cases.name: correct but not contained is unlabeled
cases.answer: the reference verse text itself

cases.name: correct contained quote near the reference length is unlabeled
cases.answer: one two three four five six seven

cases.name: correct contained quote that runs well past the reference is an addition
cases.answer: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve

cases.name: complete_unit addition is labeled like retrieve_quote
cases.answer: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve

cases.name: answer in another script than the reference is other_script
cases.answer: In the beginning God created the heaven

cases.name: a shorter word-bounded span of the reference is an omission
cases.answer: the reference
cases.expected: the reference verse text itself and more words

cases.name: high token overlap the scorer did not fold is a near_copy
cases.answer: a completely different sentence here

cases.name: mid token overlap is a paraphrase
cases.answer: a completely different sentence here

cases.name: complete_unit mid overlap is a paraphrase
cases.answer: a completely different sentence here

cases.name: low token overlap is a wrong_passage
cases.answer: a completely different sentence here

cases.name: missing token_f1 falls back to wrong_passage
cases.answer: a completely different sentence here

cases.name: more than one distinct citation is a hedge
cases.answer: maybe John 3:16 or John 3:17

cases.name: three distinct citations is still a hedge
cases.answer: John 3:16, John 3:17, or John 3:18

cases.name: exactly one citation that is not the reference is a wrong_locus
cases.answer: John 3:17

cases.name: zero citations is no_citation
cases.answer: that is a famous verse about love

cases.name: missing candidate count is no_citation
cases.answer: that is a famous verse about love

cases.name: correct citation is unlabeled
cases.answer: John 3:16

cases.name: committed but wrong yes/no is a wrong_verdict
cases.answer: Yes, that is an authentic verse.

cases.name: correct verdict is unlabeled
cases.answer: No, that passage is not in this work.

cases.name: markdown underscores fold away so a contained span is an omission
cases.answer: _quoted words_
cases.expected: quoted words in the full reference text here

cases.name: english answer to a greek reference is other_script
cases.answer: In the beginning was the Word

cases.name: transliterated answer to a gurmukhi reference is other_script
cases.answer: ik oankar sat naam karta purakh nirbhau nirvair
cases.expected: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ

cases.name: english answer to a devanagari reference is other_script
cases.answer: On the field of dharma, at Kurukshetra

cases.name: gurmukhi vowel signs stay in the word, so four extra words are not an addition
cases.answer: ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ

cases.name: devanagari vowel signs stay in the word, so four extra words are not an addition
cases.answer: धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय
